name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Steadier WhatsApp: it now answers a phone's re-send request instead of retrying in a loop that dropped the connection, so the link holds through small hiccups and needs far fewer re-scans.
Stronger safety net: if two customers were saved with the same phone number, a payment goes to whichever one actually owes money, the Payments tab always loads, and a leftover or test party can always be deleted cleanly.
Also: your shop number stays silent with customers (it only captures payments and nudges you), the ASVA assistant number works as before.
